node_inventory.text: the camera uses a short exposure

turns.speaker: author
turns.text: If the sky is cloudless, the camera uses a short exposure.

turns.speaker: author
turns.text: To restate the same rule in different words: whenever no clouds cover the sky, the shutter interval is brief.

turns.speaker: author
turns.text: However, “the sky is cloudless” does not imply “the lens is capped”.
